description: A9 (scheduled proactive engine): one host capture cycle (operating.host: the Portal sales orders into the source mirror, the PLXCUSTOMERS 'Customer Documents' folder through the GET-only Graph reader), the projection built, then offline over it the scheduled engine (operating.proactive_engine): set-based SQL rules over every current record of the projection store (late or unconfirmed purchase orders, PO line versus receipt quantity, receipts without a QC record, sales orders without a customer PO from operating.customer_po_coverage's full mirror scan, expired quotes, conflicting quantities) plus the attested-document card rules, folded into the persisted gap inbox; then the inbox read per reader, trimmed by that reader's grant. Passes with scanned covering the whole store (scope_truncated false) and at least one cited gap; counts and enums only, never an identifier or value.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; the module test is injected-transport (operating/tests/test_proactive_engine.py LiveCheckTest: the spec's own command over the case.customer_po_missing world, the in-process FakeWorkbench and a fake drive for the site; its expectations checked on the real summary; a Portal answering HTTP 500 at capture meets expect_blocked). It reuses that check's host config and live audience files (read only). scanned is the count of every current record in the projection store the set-based detectors ran over; scope_truncated is true when one of them was truncated or failed (the customer-PO detector is truncated when the mirror scan was not complete), so the check is red then rather than a pass on a partial store. Green needs a detected gap that carries a citation (json_min gaps_cited >= 1); a run that finds none is a truthful red, never a pass. receipt_without_qc reads blocked (qc_link_not_declared) while the schema declares no QC relation (upstream ask Q3); the card rules read at most operating.proactive_engine.CARD_BOUND document cards and say truncated past it. The detectors are fixture-proven in the module's DetectorTest; this live run can raise only the ones the day's captures hold.
